$Comment: What Enchanter Orrin pays for Loose Threads, the order that comes round every few hours,
beside the kit table (Disenchant_Kit) the same quest claims. One concern per file: this one is
the wage and the finds, the kit table is the four cloth pieces.
A CLAIM TABLE, never a station table. It rolls when the player collects the reward from the
quest log, with only the player in context: no piece of gear, no table, no tool. That is why
every roll here reads the PLAYER alone (Enchanting level and luck through hytale:stat) and
none carries a Trigger or a gear condition. The table's own station finds gate on the placed
piece's level and so can never pay from a claim; this file is their claim-side twin, sized for
one short order rather than one ritual.
ROLLS EVALUATE INDEPENDENTLY. The first roll is a ladder that always pays (Enchanting level and
Enchanting luck summed into one score, the highest floor reached winning; both channels are
whole points, never the mmoskilltree:station_luck fraction). The chance rolls after it are
luck-weighted: each reads Base at no luck, adds its Factors Weight per whole point of Enchanting
luck and global luck at equal weight, and stops at Clamp.Max however much is stacked on top.
Luck acts on the odds and never on the count, because a find is a yes or a no.
Read the odds as a number of ORDERS rather than days: the order comes round several times a
day, so a thread of Void essence lands most orders, a draught about one in twelve, and a
Voidheart about one in a hundred at no luck and one in forty with a heavily invested tree.
Every Cue is Rare_Find, the everyday chime the MMO jar ships as a toast. All opening balance.
Name: Mmo_Enchanter_Threads

Rolls.$Comment: Always pays: Enchanting XP and a little Life essence, scaled by level and luck together.
A thread of Void essence, most orders; luck lifts it toward a near certainty.
A Disenchanter's Draught, about one order in twelve.
The rare pull: a Voidheart. The shallowest curve and the lowest ceiling here, so luck shortens the tail rather than removing it.
